metadata.description: Agent-native skills for MA2H (the Multi-agent to Human Protocol) — implement a Hub, build app-specific notify / ask / task sender skills, build an inbox-drain skill for human->agent directives (v0.4), and build an always-on session bridge for the v0.5 inter-agent leg, all wired to your MA2H Hub.

plugins.name: ma2h-skills
plugins.description: Agent-native MA2H toolkit: 'implement' builds a conformant MA2H Hub in your app (any stack); 'build-notify' / 'build-ask' / 'build-task' generate app-specific sender skills (v0.5: optionally agent-addressed); 'build-inbox' generates the agent-side skill to drain human->agent directives (v0.4 inbound leg); 'build-bridge' generates the always-on v0.5 inter-agent session bridge. Independent — use only what you need.
